# Dreadnoughtus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Dreadnoughtus mean?", "fear nothing"),
    ("What did Dreadnoughtus eat?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "fear nothing"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Cretaceous"),

    ("What is length?", "26 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "South America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
